help.overview: KTOC Notices lists every event notice published by KTOC (KeepTrack Operations Center): relocations, departures, fragmentations and other changes KTOC detects in the public catalog. Each notice links to its full analysis on keeptrack.space.
help.statuses:
• Potential: KTOC published the event from the first data that showed it.
  • Confirmed: newer data matched the published event.
  • Canceled: newer data contradicted the event. The row is struck through; hover the status to read the reason.
help.howToUse:
1. Open KTOC Notices from the drawer (Events mode). The newest 100 notices load, newest event first.
  2. Choose All or Active only, and pick an event type to narrow the list.
  3. Click a row to select the satellite and move the clock to the event time. Play or pause stays as it was.
  4. Click the link icon to open the full notice on keeptrack.space in a new tab.
  5. Select Refresh to load the latest notices.
help.tip1: Selecting a satellite with notices adds a KTOC Notices card to the satellite info box.
help.tip2: Use the command palette entry "KTOC notices for selected satellite" to list every notice for the current selection.
help.tip3: A row for a satellite that is not in the loaded catalog still opens its notice; it cannot be selected in the 3D view.
